name: mage-dbt-toolkit
description: Conventions and skills for Mage.ai (OSS) + dbt + PostgreSQL pipelines: shared Mage/dbt mechanics, new-pipeline scaffolding, GlitchTip error triage, a Conventional Commits standard, and a reusable CLAUDE.md template with a worked example. The /init-project command drafts a new repo's CLAUDE.md from what the repo already says and audits it for leftover placeholders.
